lines.t: Hear it, earth.
Your towers got lights, but no life.
Your kings wear gold, but they cannot buy one more breath.
You built your empires on blood, lust, lies, and dead men’s bones—
Now the King is coming.
YahuShua reigns.
City full of neon, soul full of famine,
Man made a god outta cash and a cannon,
Babylon flexin’, but the clock still scan him,
Every proud mouth get silenced by the Lamb when He lands in.
No campaign, no crown made by the vote,
No banker, no beast, no snake in a coat,
Can bargain with the One who holds the stars by the throat,
When the last trumpet blasts, every counterfeit chokes.
You call evil freedom, call perversion “progress,”
Dress death in a suit, sell fear as a process,
Build your whole house on sand and a nonsense—
Then act surprised when the storm leaves no address.
You ignored every warning, laughed at the watchman,
Mocked the Word, then you praised your destruction,
But the King ain’t runnin’ from a world in corruption—
He’s coming through the clouds with a righteous combustion.
No bunker deep enough.
No screen bright enough.
No army stacked enough.
The Judge is coming up.
YahuShua! King over the planet!
Kingdoms of men? He dismantles, commands it!
Fire in His eyes, truth in His hand,
Every false throne fall when He steps on the land!
YahuShua! Hear the war drums pound!
Pride goes down when the King comes down!
Not the end for the ones who repent—
It’s the death of the lie and the rise of His government!
I see marble idols crack in the seismic,
Media prophets go mute when the light hits,
Every fake crown, every deal, every hybrid
Kingdom gets weighed and the verdict is violent.
Not man’s violence—this is holiness striking,
The rot getting cut from the roots it was hiding,
The earth been groaning, the nations been fighting,
Now the rightful King comes riding.
He ain’t coming for your image and clout,
He ain’t impressed by the chains hanging out,
He wants the heart that you locked in a drought,
Break that stone chest, let the real man out.
Repent ain’t weak—it’s a blade through deception,
A man stops lying when he faces correction,
Drop your rebellion, receive the protection,
Bow to the King or drown in your reflection.
You wanted a world without YaHuWaH.
Look at it.
A machine with no mercy.
A pleasure pit with no peace.
A thousand distractions—and still no escape from death.
But mercy is still calling before the hammer falls.
Turn.
Come out.
YahuShua is YaHuWaH.
YahuShua! King over the planet!
Kingdoms of men? He dismantles, commands it!
Fire in His eyes, truth in His hand,
Every false throne fall when He steps on the land!
YahuShua! Hear the war drums pound!
Pride goes down when the King comes down!
Not the end for the ones who repent—
It’s the death of the lie and the rise of His government!
Then out the ash comes a world made clean,
No bought-out judge, no corrupt regime,
No starving child under tyrant schemes,
Righteousness floods where the graveyards screamed.
Swords laid down, truth sits high,
The Lamb is the Lion, no more disguise,
New earth under righteous skies,
Every knee bends, every tongue testifies.
So don’t get caught worshipping dust and chrome,
This planet ain’t yours, you’re living in His home,
The King is returning to claim His throne—
YahuShua reigns, and He reigns alone.
The kingdoms of this world do not get the last word.
YahuShua does.
Repent while mercy still speaks.
The King is coming.
